resources.string: Keeps the ghost floating above other apps.
Your ghost\'s box. Hold him to pet him.

That block is Android's, not Ghostly's — it applies to any app installed outside the Play Store. Unlock it once:

1. Open app info below
2. Tap ⋮ in the top-right corner
3. Tap "Allow restricted settings"
4. Come back and grant "Display over other apps"
Feeding him and letting him nap are always free. Tokens buy treats, clothes and emojis — and they keep, so you can save up for something special.
+%1$d every day · day %2$d of your streak pays +%3$d
Treats are used up when you give them. A Gift is the one that really wins him back when he\'s cross.
Clothes are his to keep. He can wear one hat, one face thing and one neck thing at a time — tap Wearing to take something off.
He wears one emoji at a time. It floats up over his head when he\'s happy — petted, fed, playing, or just pleased with himself.
Tokens are earned, never bought: +%1$d every day, plus extra for streak milestones.
You need %1$d more tokens. You get %2$d every day, and more for streak milestones.
Streak: %1$d days. Look after him today to keep it.
No streak yet. Look after him today to start one.
He lets you know when your streak is about to run out, when he\'s hungry, cross or worn out, and when he misses you. Never before 8am or after 11pm, and never more than a few a day.
Notifications are off — turn them on

He is intangible out there: every tap goes straight through him, so nothing he floats over is ever blocked. Feeding and petting happen in his box on the Home tab — that is the one place he can be touched.

Phones put background apps to sleep to save battery — Samsung especially. If Ghostly stops floating after an hour or two, set his battery usage to Unrestricted and turn off \"Put app to sleep\" for him.
Signing in keeps your ghost if you change phone, and keeps his token balance honest. He works exactly the same without it.

Off, he is intangible: every tap goes straight through him to whatever is underneath. On, you can tap and drag him over other apps — but taps that land on him no longer reach the app behind.
